items.title: 1 Value Stock with Impressive Fundamentals and 2 We Find Risky
items.summary: Value stocks typically trade at discounts to the broader market, offering patient investors the opportunity to buy businesses when they’re out of favor. The key risk, however, is that these stocks are usually cheap for a reason, and a low valuation can reflect underlying business challenges rather than a genuine bargain.

items.title: What Does American International Group (AIG) Gain From Its Cloud Outage Cover?
items.summary: American International Group (NYSE:AIG) introduced a parametric cloud outage cyber insurance solution for US clients, developed with Parametrix. The product focuses on business interruption risks linked to outages at third party cloud and software service providers. Claims are based on predefined outage triggers and external monitoring data, which is intended to support a faster claims process.
